scripts.dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && concurrently -n API,WEB -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run start -w apps/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
scripts.build:web:dev: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web -- -c development
scripts.build:web:pre: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web -- -c pre
scripts.build:web:prod: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/web -- -c production
